Starting with the following proposal for documenting the handling of multiple concurrent sessions:

|     #      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | L1  | L2  | L3  |
| :--------: | :----- | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| **1.3.2** | Verify documentation for intended behavior and handling of multiple concurrent (parallel) sessions initiated for the same account or identity including all controls intended to terminate one or multiple active sessions. | ✓  | ✓ | ✓ |

L1 requirement based on 3.8.2, 3.8.5, and 3.8.6.
